body:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: trace-exporter (otel-collector) failing to send batches to Honeycomb - 5xx responses detected. Severity: P2. First seen: 2026-10-12T03:07:14Z
PD-Oncall: paging @Joe Miller (oncall) - can you ack?
Joe Miller: acked. looking now. seeing a spike of ExportErrors in collector logs.
Amy Chen: I see the same in traces: lots of sessions with missing spans after 03:05 UTC. Correlates with collector error rate.
Maria Lopez: grabbing honeycomb logs. seeing 502/503 from honeycomb-ingest endpoint. example: ```2026-10-12T03:05:26Z exporter=hc status=502 body="Bad Gateway" retries=3```
Kevin Patel: any config changes rolled in recently? we rolled a new batching change yesterday but it was small.
Joe Miller: no recent config on prod collector. Batching looks normal. request sizes seem larger tho - some services sent big prefixed spans. could be triggering backend rate limits.
Amy Chen: can we temporarily disable trace forwarding to Honeycomb to stop retries/backpressure? route traces to a buffered file sink and fallback exporter?
Maria Lopez: creating quick config patch to stop exporting and drop to local disk. applying now: ```kubectl patch deploy otel-collector -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"otel-collector","env":[{"name":"HC_ENABLE_EXPORT","value":"false"}]}]}}}}'```
incident-bot: PD incident updated: status -> investigating, assign -> Joe Miller, priority -> P2.
Joe Miller: patch applied. exporter env toggled off. metrics show exporter error rate dropping and pipeline latency stabilizing.
Kevin Patel: good. please confirm customer impact: are traces lost or buffered?
Amy Chen: currently collector configured with disk-queue; spans buffered for up to 2h. new incoming traces accepted but not forwarded. so customers will see a gap in Honeycomb data until we re-enable and drain.
PD-Oncall: paging Honeycomb Support -> shared account ticket created: https://support.honeycomb.io/t/12345. Included exporter errors and sample logs.
Honeycomb Support: (automated reply) Thanks for the report — we're investigating an ingestion issue in eu-west-1 region affecting some customers; engineering triage engaged. We'll update in ~15m.
Maria Lopez: noted region eu-west-1. our exporter endpoint was eu-west-1. Do we have a cross-region backup exporter configured?
Joe Miller: we have otlp fallback to newrelic in some services but not platform-wide. I can enable OTLP->NewRelic route for critical services as temporary measure.
Kevin Patel: prioritize API routing, auth, and billing downstreams. Loss of traces there increases investigation time for customers.
Amy Chen: I'll open a playbook run: https://playbooks.internal/run/trace-export-honeycomb-failure and add steps for customer comms.
Joe Miller: enabling partial routing to NewRelic for these services now. Command: ```kubectl apply -f /manifests/otel/fallback-newrelic.yaml -n prod```
Maria Lopez: applied. I can see exporter metrics for NewRelic start receiving data for the selected services. Honeycomb traffic remains blocked.
PD-Oncall: Customer impact assessment: internal dashboard shows ~12% of requests across the fleet currently lacking full trace breakdowns in Honeycomb; critical customer tenants (3) are impacted intermittently. No errors in uptime or request success.
Kevin Patel: prepare a short status note for customer success to send to affected accounts: explain missing spans, estimated time to full restore once Honeycomb confirms.
Joe Miller: Honeycomb just replied: engineers identified a regression in their ingest mutator; patch rolling out now. ETA 45-90m to full restore.
Amy Chen: plan: keep exporter off, continue buffering for up to 2h, keep partial routing to NewRelic for critical services, monitor buffer drain once Honeycomb is healthy.
Maria Lopez: scheduling a handoff to DS-night oncall at 04:30 UTC. leaving runbook steps and mitigation commands in the channel.
Joe Miller: assigning postmortem owner -> Amy Chen. Amy will draft timeline and impact. I will keep ownership on mitigation until handoff.
PD-Oncall: acknowledged. creating incident timeline entry and tagging for follow-up: telemetry-export-gap-2026-10-12.
Honeycomb Support: update: patch deployed to ingest fleet in eu-west-1. We're seeing reduced 5xx rates; continuing monitoring.
Amy Chen: good news. readiness check: can we re-enable HC exporter in a controlled manner? propose canary with 5% of traffic for 10m.
Joe Miller: will run canary: ```kubectl set env deployment/otel-collector HC_ENABLE_EXPORT=true --record && kubectl label pod otel-collector-canary canary=yes```
Maria Lopez: canary enabled. initial metrics: no 5xx and low retries so far.
Kevin Patel: if canary stable for 10m, plan full rollout and then monitor buffer drain and duplication risk. ensure idempotency headers enabled to avoid double counting.
Amy Chen: canary stable at 10m. rolling to 100%.
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. export pipeline restored to Honeycomb; buffer drain in progress.
Joe Miller: monitoring buffer drain. approximate catch-up time ~30-60m depending on queue size.
PD-Oncall: closing pager for active mitigation phase. handing to post-incident review. Customer comms drafted and sent.
Amy Chen: assigned follow-ups: postmortem (Amy Chen), vendor escalation notes (Joe Miller), configure cross-region exporter fallback (Maria Lopez).
Kevin Patel: thanks team. let's capture action items and owners in the postmortem doc.
Joe Miller: noted. I'll add logs and timeline. anyone else?
Maria Lopez: will open a config PR for global OTLP fallback and add test to ensure exporters can failover gracefully.
Honeycomb Support: final update: all ingest nodes healthy, no further errors seen. We apologize for the disruption.
Amy Chen: post-incident checklist done. closing thread after doc published. :white_check_mark:
